interpretation: Reverse Kaplan-Meier estimates potential follow-up by treating deaths as censored and treating originally censored observations as events. This is not median overall survival and is not the median of os_days.
statement: Median potential follow-up by reverse KM: 5.39 years (95% CI 5.29 to 5.49).
note_on_observed_median: The median of observed os_days is retained only as a range descriptor. It must not be labeled median follow-up or Kaplan-Meier median survival.
